blocks.text: Canvas is an editing area in ChatGPT for longer work. You use it for a draft, a script, a report section, or a block of code. Instead of scrolling through a long reply, you keep the text in one place and ask for changes to it. This guide shows how to open canvas on a Mac, what each tool does, and what to do when it is not there.
What canvas does in ChatGPT

A normal ChatGPT reply sits in the chat thread. Canvas moves a document or code out of that thread, so you can edit it as a whole. The reply stays in the chat, and the draft lives in canvas. That split helps when you revise the same text many times. It also helps when you want to copy the final version without the chat around it.
Is canvas still in your ChatGPT app?

Start here, because the answer decides which steps you follow. In December 2024, an OpenAI community thread reported that canvas and Projects were missing from the macOS desktop app. A reply said the Mac app did not have that function yet, but it was coming.

The bigger question is 2026. Two third-party sites say OpenAI removed canvas from GPT-5.5 Instant and GPT-5.5 Thinking on May 28, 2026. AI Toolbox quotes a release note that says canvas will no longer be available in those models. OpenAI's own release notes and writing-block help article could not be opened for this guide, so the removal is not confirmed by OpenAI. OpenAI's Academy canvas page, last updated May 29, 2026, still describes canvas, which conflicts with the reports.
Three checks before you follow the steps

items: Check your plan in ChatGPT > Settings. Reports say Free and Go users could not use canvas after the change.
Open the model picker with ⌃⇧M and note which model you are on. The reports name GPT-5.5 Instant and GPT-5.5 Thinking as the models that lost canvas.
Start a new chat with ⌘N and type /canvas. If nothing opens, use the writing and code block route later in this guide.

blocks.text: These checks take little time, and they save you from following steps that cannot work on your account. If all three pass, the steps below should match your screen. If one fails, jump to the fallback section, because the rest of the steps depend on the first answer.
How to open canvas in the ChatGPT Mac app

The steps below follow OpenAI's Academy guide. It is the only OpenAI page found that describes canvas steps. The guide names two routes, a slash command and the ➕ button. It gives no Mac menu path, and no canvas keyboard shortcut appears in OpenAI's shortcut reference. So the steps stay inside the chat, where you can see the controls.
Edit inside canvas with the inline tools

Once canvas is open, OpenAI lists three inline tools: Suggest edits, Adjust tone/length, and Polish. Each one changes the draft in front of you. The point is to change one part at a time, so you can see what changed. Use them in a set order. Start with Suggest edits for the content, move to Adjust tone/length for voice, and finish with Polish for sentence-level work.

Here is a worked example. Say you drafted a project update that reads flat and runs long. Run Suggest edits first, to tighten the argument and remove a repeated point. Then use Adjust tone/length to make the voice friendlier for a team channel. Run Polish last, for the final read. Copy the result once you are happy with it.
Restore an earlier draft and close canvas

The Academy guide says canvas keeps earlier drafts, and that you can use version history to restore one. It gives no menu path for that control, so look near the canvas controls first. If you still cannot find it, copy your latest text into a note before a big change. That gives you a manual backup, whatever the app does.

Closing canvas is a separate step. Zapier's guide describes a close icon beside the canvas title. That guide assumes GPT-4o, so the icon may look different now. Copy the final draft before you close the pane, and paste it into your document.
Mac shortcuts that help when canvas is hard to find
OpenAI's command reference lists the keys below for the Mac app. That reference is a Codex-branded docs page, so it may not match your version exactly. Press ⌘/ in the app to see its own list.

items: ⌘, opens Settings, where you check your plan.
⌘N starts a new chat, and ⇧⌘N starts a temporary chat.
⌃⇧M opens the model picker, and ⌃⇧V starts voice chat.
⌃1, ⌃2, and ⌃3 switch between Chat, Work, and Codex in the new desktop app.

blocks.text: Shortcuts do not bring back a missing feature. They get you to the right screen faster, and that is all they do here.
When canvas is gone: writing blocks and code blocks

If canvas is not available for your model, the replacement is inside the reply. Reports from The AI Career Lab and AI Toolbox say writing blocks replaced canvas for writing. A writing block is an editable text area in the conversation. A code block lets you copy the code, preview it, or run it. Both reports come from third-party sites, so test the behavior on a short draft first.

blocks.text: Mistakes people make with canvas on Mac

Most problems come from three habits. People type /canvas on the wrong model, trust an old workaround, or forget to copy the draft before a change. Each habit wastes time, and each one is easy to fix.

items: Trusting a 2024 workaround as if it were current. The October 2024 Safari thread had no staff reply, so treat its fix as a test.
Looking for canvas in ChatGPT Classic. OpenAI reportedly stops Classic on January 30, 2027, so learn the unified app.
Assuming a free account has canvas. Reports say Free and Go users could not use it after the change.
Following Zapier's steps as current. That guide is from the GPT-4o era and gives no article date.

blocks.text: Mac app changes in 2026

The Mac app has changed shape this year. Wikipedia reports that OpenAI merged the Codex app with the ChatGPT desktop app on July 9, 2026. The new unified app puts Chat, Work and Codex in one interface. ChatGPT Classic, the older macOS app, is being wound down, with a reported stop date of January 30, 2027. Analytics Insight does not mention canvas in its report, so the canvas location in the new app is still unclear.
Which Macs can run the ChatGPT app

iGeeksBlog says the ChatGPT Mac app needs an Apple silicon Mac with M1 or newer, running macOS 14 Sonoma or later. The app is not on the Mac App Store. That guide gives no app version number, so you cannot match your build to it. Intel support could not be confirmed, so check OpenAI's requirements before you install on an Intel Mac.
When to use canvas and when to stay in chat

Use canvas when the output is a document, a script, or code you will revise. Stay in the chat for short answers, quick questions, and brainstorms. The chat is faster for a one-line reply, and canvas is better for a page you will edit again and again.

If you use voice, the [voice mode guide](/how-to/use-voice-mode-in-chatgpt) covers that side. To share a file with ChatGPT, see [how to attach a file in ChatGPT](/how-to/attach-a-file-in-chatgpt). Keep the chat for ideas and the canvas for the final text.
What to do next

Pick one test draft and run the full loop once. Open canvas, use one inline tool, restore an earlier version, then close the pane. If a step fails, you know exactly where your app differs from this guide. If you open ChatGPT often, the [Option+Space shortcut guide](/how-to/use-the-option-space-shortcut-in-chatgpt) covers quick access to the chat bar.

faq.question: Is canvas still in ChatGPT on Mac?
faq.answer: Reports say OpenAI removed canvas from GPT-5.5 Instant and GPT-5.5 Thinking on May 28, 2026. OpenAI's own Academy page still describes it. Check your model and plan, then test /canvas in a new chat.

faq.question: Why can't I find canvas in ChatGPT on Mac?
faq.answer: The usual causes are the model you chose, your plan, or a change to the app. Reports say Free and Go users lost canvas. Check those first, then use writing and code blocks if the feature is gone.

faq.question: What is the keyboard shortcut for canvas on Mac?
faq.answer: No canvas shortcut appears in OpenAI's shortcut reference. Type /canvas in the message box, or click the ➕ button and choose Canvas. Press ⌘/ in the app to see its own shortcut list.

faq.question: Where is canvas in the Mac menu bar?
faq.answer: No Mac menu path for canvas was found in OpenAI's guide. The Academy steps start in the message box. The menu bar has ChatGPT > Settings (⌘,), which is where you check your plan.

faq.question: Can I restore an earlier canvas draft?
faq.answer: OpenAI's Academy guide says version history restores earlier drafts. It gives no menu path, so look near the canvas controls. Copy your latest text into a note before a major change.

faq.question: Does canvas work in Safari on Mac?
faq.answer: An October 2024 community thread reported that canvas did not open a new window in Safari or on iPad. One user said choosing the right model and typing Open Canvas helped. No staff reply confirmed it.

faq.question: Do I need a paid plan for canvas?
faq.answer: Reports say Free and Go users could not use canvas after the change. Paid users may keep it on legacy models for a limited time, but the reports do not name those models or an end date.

faq.question: Is ChatGPT Classic still available on Mac?
faq.answer: Analytics Insight reports that Classic stops functioning on January 30, 2027. Until then it gets model updates, bug fixes, and security patches. The unified desktop app brings Chat, Work and Codex together.

steps.name: Open the ChatGPT app on your Mac
steps.text: Open ChatGPT from Applications or the Dock. The Mac app is not on the Mac App Store, so you download it from OpenAI. Sign in with the account whose plan you want to check.
steps.tip: Press ⌥Space to open the chat bar while the app is running.

steps.name: Check your plan in Settings
steps.text: Open ChatGPT > Settings and confirm which plan you are on. Reports say Free and Go users could not use canvas after the change, so a free account may not show it.
steps.tip: Write down the plan name before you go further, so you can compare it with the reports.

steps.name: Pick a model in the picker
steps.text: Open the model picker with ⌃⇧M and note the model you choose. Reports say GPT-5.5 Instant and GPT-5.5 Thinking lost canvas. Paid users may keep it on legacy models for a limited time, but the reports do not name those models.
steps.tip: A 2024 Safari thread said choosing the right model in the dropdown helped. That is a user report, not an official fix.

steps.name: Start a fresh chat
steps.text: Press ⌘N to start a new chat. A clean thread makes it easier to see whether canvas works on the model you picked.
steps.tip: The keyboard shortcut list is at ⌘/ in the app. Use it if the keys in this guide do not match.

steps.name: Open canvas with /canvas or the ➕ button
steps.text: Click the message box and type /canvas, then press Return. You can also click the ➕ button and select Canvas. Both routes come from OpenAI's Academy guide, last updated May 29, 2026.
steps.tip: A 2024 user report said no Canvas button appeared in the Mac app's tools menu. If the ➕ menu has no Canvas entry, use /canvas.

steps.name: Describe the draft you want
steps.text: Tell ChatGPT what you want, who will read it, and how it should sound. Canvas holds the result in its editing area, so you can keep changing it without retyping the request.
steps.tip: A clear request saves more time than any shortcut. Name the format, the audience, and the length in words.

steps.name: Use the three inline tools
steps.text: OpenAI's guide lists Suggest edits, Adjust tone/length, and Polish as the inline tools. Use one tool at a time, then read the draft before you run the next one.
steps.tip: Run Polish last. Polishing a paragraph you later cut wastes time.

steps.name: Restore an earlier draft
steps.text: The Academy guide says to use version history to restore an earlier draft. It gives no menu path, so look near the canvas controls first. If you cannot find it, copy the latest text into a note before a big change.
steps.tip: Save a copy before any large rewrite. That copy works as your own version history.

steps.name: Close canvas when you finish
steps.text: Use the close control beside the canvas title. Zapier's guide describes this icon, but it is written for the GPT-4o era, so the icon may have moved.
steps.tip: Copy the final draft before you close the pane, so you keep it somewhere safe.

steps.name: Use writing and code blocks if canvas is gone
steps.text: If canvas is missing for your model, ask for the text in the chat. Reports say writing blocks, which are editable text areas, and code blocks, which you can copy, preview, or run, now handle that work.
steps.tip: Test one short draft first, since the sources are third-party reports.

troubleshooting.problem: /canvas does nothing in the Mac app
troubleshooting.fix: Check your plan and model first. A 2024 thread reported that /canvas opened canvas on the Mac app. That report is old, so treat it as a test, not a fix.

troubleshooting.problem: Canvas is missing from the ➕ menu
troubleshooting.fix: Type /canvas in the message box instead. A 2024 report said no Canvas button showed in the Mac app's tools menu.

troubleshooting.problem: Canvas does not open in Safari or on iPad
troubleshooting.fix: An October 2024 thread said choosing the right model in the dropdown and typing Open Canvas helped. No staff reply confirmed it, so test it on a short draft.
Compare your model and plan with the reports. If canvas is gone for your model, use writing blocks and code blocks in the reply.

troubleshooting.problem: ChatGPT Classic looks different or stopped
troubleshooting.fix: OpenAI is folding Classic into the unified desktop app. Reports give January 30, 2027 as the stop date, so move to the unified app before then.
